headline: The story of GTA Vice City
title: The Story of GTA Vice City | Tommy Vercetti, 1986, Ray Liotta | Classic Games
video_script: GTA Vice City came out in two thousand two, with a story set in nineteen eighty six in Vice City, a city inspired by Miami. The hero is Tommy Vercetti, voiced by Hollywood actor Ray Liotta. Its eighties soundtrack and neon streets are still legendary. And now Vice City is coming back in GTA 6! Do you remember the original? Comment below!
description: GTA Vice City (2002): Miami-inspired Vice City in 1986, Tommy Vercetti voiced by Ray Liotta - and Vice City returns in GTA 6.
